name: Ventab XL 150mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About VENTAB XL 150MG TABLET

VENTAB XL 150MG TABLET contains Venlafaxine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antidepressants. It is used in adults to manage depression, anxiety disorders and panic attacks (fear).

Depression is a mental health disorder characterized by persistant depressed mood, lack of interest, feeling of guilt, sleep disturbances or sucidial thoughts for a prolonged period (more than 2 weeks) that causes significant impairment in performing day-to-day activities.

Before taking VENTAB XL 150MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have diabetes or any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have or have a family history of bipolar disorder, mania or epilepsy. Do not take VENTAB XL 150MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor.

The most common side effects of taking VENTAB XL 150MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, drowsiness, lack of sleep, dry mouth and sexual problems. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of VENTAB XL 150MG TABLET

It is used in adults to manage:

Depression
Anxiety disorders (both generalized and social-anxiety)
Panic attacks (fear)
mechanismOfAction:
How VENTAB XL 150MG TABLET Works

VENTAB XL 150MG TABLET is a potent antidepressant drug. It contains a medicine called venlafaxine which is a selective serotonin and norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor (SSNRI). It acts by increasing the levels of certain chemicals (serotonin and norepinephrine) within the brain that elevates your mood and stabilizes mental health. As a result, it makes you feel active and energetic and reduces unnecessary fear and anxiety.
usageDetails:
How to use VENTAB XL 150MG TABLET

Take VENTAB XL 150MG TABLET with food or as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not cursh or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of theray for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not stop taking VENTAB XL 150MG TABLET abruptly as it may lead to withdrawal symptoms such as aggressiveness, tiredness, dizziness, sleeplessness, nightmares, dry mouth, nervousness, agitation, confusion or ringing in the ears.

warnings.details: VENTAB XL 150MG TABLET should be used in pregnant women only if considered necessary by the physician. Your doctor will evaluate the risks and benefits of the therapy and prescribes you with this medicine only if the benefits overweigh the risk to the growing baby. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

VENTAB XL 150MG TABLET may pass through the breast milk. Therefore, it should be used in breastfeeding women only if considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you feel dizzy or sleepy after taking VENTAB XL 150MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking VENTAB XL 150MG TABLET.
VENTAB XL 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
VENTAB XL 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take VENTAB XL 150MG TABLET if you are allergic to Venlafaxine.
VENTAB XL 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart diseases (such as high blood pressure or abnormal heartbeat). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

Before taking VENTAB XL 150MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have or ever had any bleeding problems
Have or have a family history of various mental illness (such as bipolar disorder, mania, and hypomania)
Have diabetes
Have ever felt extremely sad with suicidal thoughts or behaviour
Have or ever had seizures (fits)
Have low blood sodium levels (causing tiredness, confusion, and muscle weakness)
Have glaucoma

Use in pediatrics:

VENTAB XL 150MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before administration.

 Use in geriatrics:

VENTAB XL 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Warning & Precautions
Pregnancy

VENTAB XL 150MG TABLET should be used in pregnant women only if considered necessary by the physician. Your doctor will evaluate the risks and benefits of the therapy and prescribes you with this medicine only if the benefits overweigh the risk to the growing baby. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Breastfeeding

VENTAB XL 150MG TABLET may pass through the breast milk. Therefore, it should be used in breastfeeding women only if considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Driving and Using Machines

Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you feel dizzy or sleepy after taking VENTAB XL 150MG TABLET.

Alcohol

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking VENTAB XL 150MG TABLET.

Kidney

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions –

Before taking VENTAB XL 150MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Other medicines used to manage depression such as monoamine oxidase inhibitors (Ex. moclobemide, isocarboxazid, phenelzine and tranylcypromine), tricyclic antidepressants (Ex. amitriptyline, nortriptyline), lithium, fluoxetine, sertraline, citalopram, escitalopram etc.
Buprenorphine (a medicine used for pain relief or opiod dependence)
Linezolid (an antibiotic used to manage bacterial infection)
Sibutramine (a medicine used for weight loss)
Intravenous methylene blue (used to manage abnormal methemoglobin levels in blood)
Medicines used to manage migraine headaches (such as sumatriptan, zolmitriptan)
Fentanyl (an opioid analgesic used for pain relief)
Tramadol (used for pain relief)
Tryptophan (an aminoacid used for maintaing mental health)
Amphetamines (used as CNS stimulants) Ex. dexamphetamine and lisdexamphetamine
Dextromethorphan (a cough medicine)
Methadone (a medicine used to manage pain or drug addiction)
Pentazocaine (an anesthetic used to cause numbness before surgeries)
St. John’s Wort (a herbal medicine used to manage depression)
Medicines that can affect blood clotting (such as aspirin or warfarin)
Medicines used to manage psychotic disorders (Ex. chlorpromazine, prochlorperazine, trihexiphenidyl, haloperidol or risperidone)
Medicines used to manage heart problems (Ex. quinidine, amiodarone, sotalol, metoprolol or defatilide)
Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. erythromycin or moxifloxacin)
Antihistamines (used to manage allergies) Ex. fexofenadine, levocetirizine
Medicines used to manage fungal infection (Ex. ketoconazole)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally consumed more VENTAB XL 150MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdosage might include fast heartbeat, sleepiness, blurred vision, fits and vomiting.
